text:
maria: experimenting with a 'staged apply' model for runtime configs. Idea: stage->canary->ramp with automatic gates. trying to balance speed and safety for routing + quota changes.

alex: can we make gates pluggable? e.g., latency gate, error gate, cost gate. console should let owners pick which gates to run.

tess: UX: recommend a default gate set (latency+error). show expected timeline and an inline graph of canary metrics. let power users tweak guard thresholds.

jun: API draft:
POST /v1/staged_applies
{ "config_id":"...", "stages": [{"percent":1, "duration_min":15}, {"percent":10, "duration_min":30}, {"percent":100, "duration_min":0}], "gates": ["error:5%","p50:20%"], "requester":"maria", "ttl":86400 }

service will schedule stage transitions and evaluate gates after each stage.

sahil: telemetry: track stage_start, stage_end, gate_eval events. attach stage_id and metrics snapshot. ops-bot can subscribe to gate failures.

ops-bot: automatic rollback if any gate fails. post details and allow manual override to continue with a strong ack.

kevin: threshold tuning is tricky. propose defaults but require each team to validate on a small self-service test harness.

maria: ok decision: default gates latency+error, default stage plan 1% for 15m -> 10% for 30m -> remainder; gate thresholds: error>5% increase or p50>20% increase. owners same as previous RFC.

alex: will include state machine in RFC and idempotency guarantees.

tess: console will render the stage timeline and gate status icons. also surface a history of past staged_applies for that config.

sahil: note: need to ensure metric baselines account for time-of-day. capture rolling baseline windows.

maria: good point. add to telemetry owner tasks.

maria: I'll consolidate both checkout and staged_apply ideas into one RFC with choices and owners. feedback welcome for 48h.

kevin: small ask: show an estimated cost delta per stage in the UI so approvers can see billing impact.

maria: added. thanks.
